before.title: High-Pressure Pipe Gallery
before.description: Superheated steam hisses through massive overhead conduits in a pressurized gallery. Checkered racing pennants hang above a pipe bench stacked with flanging tools and leather gloves. A scuffed baseball rests in a tool rack. A family photo and leather dog collar hang beside the bypass manifold.

actions.name: racing pennants
actions.description: Inspect the checkered racing banners and speed decals.
actions.inspect_message: Twin checkered racing flags and a gold number 24 decal are stuck to the conduit shroud above the workbench, honoring late-night speedway runs.

actions.name: pipe bench
actions.description: Inspect the pipe-fitting workbench and tools.
actions.inspect_message: Tungsten flanging dies and heavy pipe cutters sit beside a well-oiled composite baseball bat and a pair of worn leather work gloves stamped with the initials S.T.

actions.name: family photo
actions.description: Inspect the snapshot clipped to the magnetic toolbox.
actions.inspect_message: A holo-snapshot is clipped to the toolbox lid: three smiling young girls in softball caps with a note: 'Be careful at work, Daddy! Love Lily, Emma & Hannah.'

actions.name: bypass manifold
actions.description: Inspect the twin-loop steam bypass manifold.
actions.inspect_message: A massive twin-loop steam manifold engineered to absorb thermal shock without shedding system pressure, welded with immaculate precision.

actions.name: leather dog collar
actions.description: Inspect the worn leather collar hung from the workbench peg.
actions.inspect_message: A soft, worn leather collar looped over a brass peg beside Sherman's gloves. An engraved brass tag reads: 'Smokey — Good boy for thirteen years. Rest easy, pal.'
